messages:
mike.support: Escalating a priority handoff for Brightwell Labs - trial account. Two live blockers: SSO failing with SAML assertion error and embeddings provisioning stuck in 'queued'. Renewal/auto-convert in 12 days. Need CS to lead comms + enablement and approve any temporary concession.
asha.support: Filed ticket #4472. IdP error: AssertionConsumerService mismatch. We re-uploaded metadata, SAML debug shows ACS URL mismatch on our side.
darren-csm: @elena.cs heads-up — high renewal risk if this drags. Can CS spare someone to run the enablement + comms?
elena.cs: I can take it. Proposed immediate plan: 1) join triage call with Brightwell + Support 2) approve a provisional quota bump to let them complete evaluation 3) run a 30m enablement (SSO + embeddings) 4) follow-up and extend trial if needed. Who can action quota bump approval?
mike.support: ops-bot created a request but it awaits CS approval + manager signoff. Also their logs show repeated 401s post-assertion.
ops-bot: Quota request RB-834 created. Status: pending-cs-approval. Estimated apply time once approved: ~25 minutes.
asha.support: Embeds stuck because manifest.s3 URI missing; re-ingest attempted and failed with 503 from storage. Ops looking.
elena.cs: OK. Immediate CS actions: A) I'll join the 16:00 PT troubleshooting call B) draft brief comms to AM/exec sponsor offering 2-week evaluation extension + 10% credit if onboarding completes before renewal C) run the 30m enablement session. I'll need an owner for exec approval of any credit/quota.
darren-csm: I'll escalate to sales leadership and loop in the AM (sara@brightwell). cc me on the comms.
mike.support: Invite sent for 16:00 PT (includes logs and ticket 4472).
elena.cs: Draft comms to send after triage: "Hi Sara — we're escalating to resolve SSO and embedding provisioning. CS lead (Elena) and Support engineer assigned to fast-track. Proposed remediation: immediate config check, temporary quota bump, 30m enablement call. If resolved before renewal we'll extend trial. Can you confirm availability for 16:00 PT?" Thoughts?
asha.support: Minor edit: change to 'availability for 16:00 PT' is fine. Recommend including temporary workaround: 'use API-key-based ingestion until SSO is completed' (do not include actual key in the email).
elena.cs: Good point — will say 'temporary API-key-based ingestion available to unblock embeds'. Action owners: elena = comms + enablement; darren = escalation to AM/sales; mike = continue support triage; asha = follow storage ops; ops-bot = apply quota after CS approval.
ops-bot: RB-834 waiting for explicit approval. Reply in thread with 'approve RB-834' to proceed.
elena.cs: Approve RB-834. Approve RB-834.
ops-bot: RB-834 status updated: 'approved' — provisional quota bump applied.
asha.support: Storage team reports transient S3 503 resolved; re-ingest retried and embedding provisioning resumed to 'processing'.
mike.support: Deployed small SSO helper patch to accept alias ACS hostnames (rollback-safe). Deploy log: `deploy 2024-03-21T15:40Z helper#patch-ssocheck`. Local test user no longer hits assertion mismatch.
elena.cs: Running the 30m enablement at 17:00 PT — I'll validate SSO flow with their IdP engineer and confirm embed ingestion. After enablement I'll send a short success note + confirm trial extension details.
darren-csm: If enablement completes and embeds provision, I'll mark renewal 'healthy' in CRM and remove churn flag.
mike.support: Ticket #4472 updated with remediation steps and notes. Handoff to Elena for ongoing CS comms.
elena.cs: Thanks all. I'll post the after-action summary here within 24h with next steps and any product follow-ups needed.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: post-enablement summary due in 24h.
